name: Holoscope: Another Day Another Data
source:
Take the role of Xena Santiago, betamax rental girl by day, fabulous hacker by night. Money is sparse and your rent is months late. If you don't come home with something tonight you'll be back to a life of couchsurfing with your cat. You've got one evening of server breaking, sweet talking, and black market deals to get what you need. Are you up to the task?

[From [url=https://holoscope.itch.io/daydata]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
扮演澤娜．聖地亞哥：白天是Betamax錄影帶出租店的女店員，夜晚則是技藝高超的駭客。你手頭拮据，房租已經拖欠了好幾個月。今晚要是不能帶點收穫回家，你就得帶著貓，重新過上借宿別人家沙發的日子。你只有一個晚上的時間，靠入侵伺服器、說盡好話和黑市交易，弄到自己需要的東西。你能做到嗎？

[摘自[url=https://holoscope.itch.io/daydata]itch.io[/url]]
